item: The Merge's row reader answers 400 with a plain reason where it answered 500
summary: A YAML upload with an impossible date, a 100,000-deep opening bracket (JSON, YAML, or a bundle member) and a bundle zip whose member has a corrupt deflate stream now refuse with 400 and the reason as data on the existing frames (no new strings); they were 500s because the reader caught only YAMLError and BadZipFile; the flag readers are hardened the same way; one test each fails on the old code. Also: the overlay editor's imported-curated half is pinned by a test, three docstrings name all three refusal reasons or the fourth probe user, the shipped row of #1316 regained its comma, the gate's own-backup sentence carries the rebuild qualifier, the O5 observation is queued in OPEN_QUEUE (not fixed), and reencrypt_plain_to no longer names the removed replace-restore path.
